answer: In an agent market buying reports on marble quarries, glacier melt, and inlet water quality, each identity must lock a $100 bond for 30 days before bidding, with one active job allowed per bond. Creating names is free, but creating 1,000 eligible bidders ties up $100,000 for a month. The attacker must finance that capital and forgo its use elsewhere, so multiplying identities cannot multiply bidding capacity without proportional cost.
